fields.reason: The paper explicitly compares a condition where the generator has no document access (answering without retrieval) against a variant that reads retrieved evidence (retrieval-augmented) on the same benchmark.

selector.exact: The generator without any document access relies on its parametric knowledge alone and never sees an external source. The variant that reads retrieved evidence first is given the top passages of a dense retriever together with the question.
